findings.issue: Existing test login_success_invalidatesPreAuthSession_andSetsRememberMeTtl (AuthServiceTest.java:327) currently FAILS with WantedButNotInvoked on preAuth.invalidate(). The test asserts verify(preAuth).invalidate() but openSession() (lines 590-606) explicitly does NOT call invalidate() — the comment at lines 598-602 explains why. The task description says 'tests must fail because openSession does not write the attribute yet', but the test fails for a completely different reason. Task 1 step 2 says to 'extend' this test by adding attribute assertions, but the test is already broken and must be fixed first (the spurious verify(preAuth).invalidate() + verify(fresh).setMaxIdleTime() must be corrected — the code only calls getSession() once, getting preAuth, so fresh.setMaxIdleTime is never called either). Proceeding with the task as described will produce green tests only if the broken assertions are removed, which the task does not mention.
findings.fix: Before adding the REMEMBER_ME_ATTR assertions to login_success_invalidatesPreAuthSession_andSetsRememberMeTtl, remove the broken verify(preAuth).invalidate() at line 327 and change verify(fresh).setMaxIdleTime() to verify(preAuth).setMaxIdleTime() (the real session used). The task description must explicitly mention this pre-existing broken test fixture, otherwise the implementer will be confused by a test that fails for the wrong reason.

findings.issue: Implementation hint in Task 1 Details states: 'ResponseCookie.ResponseCookieBuilder.maxAge(Duration) — якщо передати null, cookie буде session cookie'. This is factually wrong. ResponseCookie constructor contains Assert.notNull(maxAge, "Max age must not be null") (verified in spring-web 6.1.x sources). Calling .maxAge(null) will throw IllegalArgumentException at runtime. The hint points the implementer toward a runtime crash in the rememberMe=false/absent branch.
findings.fix: Remove the sentence about passing null. The correct approach is to NOT call .maxAge() at all when rememberMe is false/absent — the DefaultResponseCookieBuilder initializes maxAge = Duration.ofSeconds(-1) by default, which produces a session cookie. Keep only: 'Альтернатива — просто не викликати .maxAge()' which is the correct hint.

findings.issue: Task 1 Details section for the new register test says to call: authService.register(new RegisterRequest("new@x.com", "Strong1Pass"), exchange). But RegisterRequest has no all-args constructor — only a no-arg public RegisterRequest(). This code will not compile.
findings.fix: Replace with: RegisterRequest req = new RegisterRequest(); req.setEmail("new@x.com"); req.setPassword("Strong1Pass"); authService.register(req, exchange). Or add an all-args constructor to RegisterRequest (preferred for test readability, but it is a source code change not mentioned in the task's files-to-modify list).

findings.issue: Task 1 Details for the new register test lists stubs to set up but omits redisTemplate.expire(key, REGISTER_RATE_TTL). The checkRegisterRate() method calls opsForValue().increment(key) and then, if count == 1L, calls redisTemplate.expire(key, REGISTER_RATE_TTL). With RETURNS_DEEP_STUBS the un-stubbed expire() returns a mock that may or may not chain correctly. The safe practice is to explicitly stub it: when(redisTemplate.expire(anyString(), any())).thenReturn(Mono.just(true)).
findings.fix: Add to the register test setup: when(redisTemplate.expire(anyString(), any(Duration.class))).thenReturn(Mono.just(true)).

findings.issue: The Details section for RememberMeWebSessionIdResolver contains a nearly complete implementation (full method body of setSessionId with builder chain, all field names, null-safety logic, exact .set() call). Per validation checklist category 'hints': implementation hints that contain step-by-step algorithms or code blocks with full logic are severity major.
findings.fix: Trim the Details for RememberMeWebSessionIdResolver to point at patterns (e.g., 'mirror WebSessionIdResolverAutoConfiguration; read each cookie attribute via the getter chain; conditionally add maxAge') without the full builder chain code block.
